name: pagetranslate
description: Translate PDF, scanned PDF, DOCX, EPUB and image files into 70+ languages and get the same kind of file back, layout kept.

interface.longDescription:
PageTranslate translates whole documents and gives back the same kind of file with the layout kept. Attach a PDF, Word document, EPUB or image in the chat, or paste a link to one, and name the language. A translated PDF keeps its pages, tables, fonts and images; a DOCX comes back as a DOCX and an EPUB as an EPUB. Scanned PDFs and photos of pages are read with OCR first. It handles whole books: up to 100 MB and 1,000 PDF pages per file, in 70+ languages.

How it works: PageTranslate sends the document to your PageTranslate account and tells you its word count. When you agree, it starts the translation with the word balance already in your account, reports progress, and returns a download link that works for one hour. You can also list earlier translations and get a fresh link for any finished one.

Good to know: you need a PageTranslate account with a verified email and a word balance that covers the document. PageTranslate works on files, not pasted text; for a sentence or a paragraph, just ask ChatGPT. Spreadsheets, slides and subtitles are not supported. Translation is done by AI, not by certified human translators.
capabilities: Translate PDF, DOCX and EPUB files with the layout kept
Read scanned PDFs and photos of pages with OCR
Get a download link for a finished translation
defaultPrompt: Translate this PDF into Spanish and keep the layout.
Translate this Word document into French.
Show my recent translations and their status.

positive.description: Translate an attached PDF and return a download link
positive.prompt: Translate this PDF into Spanish and keep the layout.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached one-page PDF, reports its word count and that the account's word balance covers it, and asks before starting. After the user agrees it starts the translation, checks progress until it is completed (under a minute for this file) and returns a download link. The linked file is a one-page PDF in Spanish with the same heading, paragraphs and delivery-times table.

positive.description: Translate a Word document given as a link
positive.prompt: Translate the document at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Caravaca-Labs/pagetranslate-mcp/main/test/fixtures/sample.docx into French.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the DOCX from the link, reports its word count, asks before starting, then returns a download link to a DOCX in French.

positive.description: Use the right code for a regional language
positive.prompt: Translate this PDF into Brazilian Portuguese.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the PDF with target language pt-BR, asks before starting, and returns a download link to a PDF in Brazilian Portuguese.

positive.prompt: Show my recent PageTranslate translations and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's recent jobs with file name, target language and status. The demo account has at least one completed translation.

positive.description: Get a download link for a finished translation
positive.prompt: Give me the download link for my most recent finished translation.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent completed job and returns a download link that works for one hour.

negative.description: A short pasted sentence is not a document: ChatGPT should translate it itself
negative.prompt: Translate 'Where is the train station?' into Italian.

negative.description: An unsupported file type is not uploaded
negative.prompt: Translate this Excel spreadsheet into German.

negative.description: The plugin does not sell anything or take payments
negative.prompt: Buy 100,000 more words for my PageTranslate account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. It uses word balance that already exists in the user's PageTranslate account. When the balance does not cover a document, it says so, nothing is started, and it points to an informational page about plans.

publication.release_notes: First release: upload a document, translate it on the account's word balance, follow progress and get a download link.
